about.description: Lighter is a verifiable zero-fee perpetual contract DEX built as a custom ZK-rollup on Ethereum, founded by Vladimir Novakovski (former Citadel quant). The protocol generates ZK proofs of all order matching and liquidations and operates a fully on-chain order book targeting CEX-grade execution. Markets cover equities, ETFs, equity indices, and commodities alongside crypto, with positions margined and cash-settled in USDC. Lighter began ZK-rollup development in 2023, launched mainnet in October 2024, and raised $68M at a $1.5B valuation in November 2025 from Founders Fund, Ribbit Capital, Haun Ventures, and Robinhood.
about.registryInfo: Lighter Labs was founded by Vladimir Novakovski, formerly a quantitative engineer/trader at Citadel. The team began developing its own ZK-rollup in 2023; mainnet launched in October 2024 and the company raised $68M at a $1.5B valuation in November 2025 from Founders Fund, Ribbit Capital, Haun Ventures, and Robinhood (a rare strategic investment from the broker).

fees.revenueNotes: Lighter perpetuals are FREE to trade for standard accounts (0 bps maker / 0 bps taker). Premium accounts (lower latency tier) pay 0.2 bps maker / 2 bps taker. Premium accounts can stake LIT for further fee discounts. Lighter is a zk-rollup perp DEX with no separate RWA fee tier — same fees apply to crypto and RWA markets. Source: https://docs.lighter.xyz/perpetual-futures/fees
